repo.ISSUE.md: label_grades gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per grade.

fix.code:
def label_grades(names, grades):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> score dict and one 'name: score' line per grade."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.score for x in grades)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
